findings_closed: Pinned wrapper execute checks isClosed via _ensureOpen before entering sqlite3_exec; autocommit getter directly enters sqlite3_get_autocommit without liveness check. close marks isClosed before calling sqlite3_close_v2. New execute(empty SQL) therefore throws on the closed wrapper before unsafe autocommit access. For an open wrapper it invokes SQLite with empty SQL but executes no SQL statement or metadata mutation.

Failure of the liveness probe enters the existing rollback-failure path, sets _poisoned and throws LocalDatabaseFailure. Queued authority access remains denied; no owner reset or reconstruction is introduced.

Shared owner/module queues and synchronous transaction callback establish no asynchronous gap between liveness check and autocommit access. This is a wrapper-close guard, not a claim to protect arbitrary external native-handle disposal or unsupported concurrent raw SQLite use.

Enhanced regression preserves real committed Tasks/Food bytes and identity, raw protected settings/writer/theme, heads and writer guards; denies queued work and Food refresh after poison, then closes idempotently and reopens the same profile proving both module and owner leases released.
